sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.
No one appears for the opposite Party No.2 despite notice.

2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.572 of 2022, under Sections 376, 363, 366,
452 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station- Dhaurahara, District- Lakhimpur Kheri,
during trial.
3. Counsel for the applicant argues that in terms of the FIR registered as a missing person report, it was alleged that the sister of the informant was enticed away by the applicant on 3.7.2022.

1 of the victim was stated as 16 years.

Subsequently in statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C, the victim stated that on 30.07.2022, she was sleeping with her mother, when two persons came to her home and took her to an agricultural field and thereafter somehow, the victim could escape on 29.8.2022.
The medical, on record, does not support the allegation of any wrong doing on the victim.

4. Counsel for the applicant draws our attention to the statement of the neighbours, who stated that the applicant used to stay since the childhood in the home of the informant and both of them (applicant and victim) had gone with consent and both of them had also married as per the information received by them.
5. It is argued that the applicant is in custody since 14.9.2022 and the trial has not even started.
The tentative age of the victim as per the medical is around 15-17 years.

6. Considering the fact that the victim stayed with the applicant for over two months and the medical is not supporting the allegation of FIR, coupled with the fact that trial is not being started,
prima facie, the mandate of Sections 35 (1) and 35 (2) of the POCSO Act is violated in the present case, as such the applicant, who has no criminal history and is in custody since 14.9.2022, is enlarged on bail.
7. Thus the bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Kunji @ Kunji Lal Chauhan be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/-
each with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.4.2024 Gurpreet Singh  Kunji @ Kunji Lal Chauhan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin, Secy. Home U.P. ...
